parties.counterparty: SFG Financial Corp, a/k/a E-Path FX (Licensor)

plans.note: Article VIX carries the all-caps warranty disclaimer and is the usual home for a consequential-damages exclusion and liability cap; check whether any cap is one-way in Licensor's favour and whether carve-outs (confidentiality, IP indemnity, willful misconduct) exist. Check general provisions (sec-p0144) for a stray cap as well.

No heading signals an indemnity; scan Article VIII, Article X and the general provisions for an IP infringement indemnity running to Licensee, and for any one-way Licensee indemnity of Licensor. If nothing usable appears, treat as missing.

Article II 'License Grant and Restrictions' plus the FIELD OF USE definition are the likely source of any restraint on the businesses or competing platforms we may use or build; the confidentiality/non-solicitation article may also embed a competitive restraint.

The defined term 'Right of First Refusal' strongly suggests an exclusivity-style constraint on Licensee's ability to source an alternative platform; locate the operative ROFR provision and any 'sole/exclusive provider' language in Article II.

Pricing appears only as per-unit volume tiers and 'Supplemental Payments'; no most-favoured-customer language is signalled. Confirm none is buried in the fee schedule before concluding absent, and note that an MFN running in our favour would not be flagged.

Article X is headed 'Confidential Information/Non Solicitation'; check mutuality, duration, scope (employees vs. customers/introducing brokers) and whether a general-advertising/unsolicited-response carve-out exists.

Article VIII is the likely term/termination article; read with the 'Initial Period' definition in Article I to see whether Licensee may exit on notice without penalty and whether Licensor has a broader walk-away or suspension right.
Check the Initial Period definition and Article VIII for automatic renewal terms, the non-renewal notice window and any renewal price escalation; a missing uplift cap is a note, not a deviation.

Governing law, venue and any arbitration clause should sit in the Article XXIV general provisions block; verify the chosen law is NY/DE/CA/England and that disputes go to courts rather than offshore arbitration.

Assignment/successors language is normally in general provisions; confirm we may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger without Licensor consent, and that our change of control is not a Licensor termination trigger.

Definitions of DERIVATIVE WORK, INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS, MORAL RIGHTS and LICENSED TECHNOLOGY plus Article II are where ownership sits; watch for any assignment to Licensor of Licensee feedback, customer data, trade data or configurations.

Article II grant clause read with AFFILIATE, FIELD OF USE, PLATFORM SOFTWARE and LICENSED SOFTWARE definitions; test whether the grant extends to affiliates and contractors and whether it is revocable at will or otherwise unilaterally suspendable.

Usage-verification/audit rights, if any, would sit with the Article II restrictions or in general provisions; check notice, frequency, on-site access and who bears cost. May be absent, which is acceptable to us.
Look for early-termination fees, shortfall charges tied to the per-transaction tiers, or interest/penalty language around Supplemental Payments before concluding no liquidated damages run against us.

Article VIX is an express all-caps disclaimer of merchantability, non-infringement, fitness and error-free operation, with no apparent affirmative performance warranty or remedy; assess against the rule's minimum warranty and repair/replace remedy.
No insurance heading appears in the outline; sweep the general provisions before treating as missing, noting that Licensor hosts the trading platform and touches our transaction data.

The volume-tier fee table plus the 'Market Day' and 'Supplemental Payments' definitions may create a minimum monthly volume or take-or-pay floor; confirm whether any shortfall must be paid and whether an exit exists.

Check the termination article and general provisions for post-termination wind-down, data return/deletion and migration assistance; confidentiality return-of-materials language in Article X is not a substitute for a transition right.
